record.title: EuroHPC updates AI Gigafactories tender deadlines and invalidates existing submissions
record.summary: EuroHPC’s AI Gigafactories tender page, updated 5 November 2026, says a technical issue invalidates all draft and submitted tenders in the system for both lots; replacement submission links are forthcoming, and applicants are told not to continue current drafts. The page retains deadlines of 4 February 2027 for Lot 1 and 3 December 2026 for Lot 2. The prior Lot 1 extension was publicly reported by the Czech ministry on 26 October to allow Member States time for national budget procedures and financial commitments. This is a change to the procurement process; it establishes no consortium awards, committed investment, facility construction, operating compute or access.
organizations: Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: On 2026-10-26, the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade reported that EuroHPC had extended the bid deadline for Lot 1, the medium-scale AI Gigafactories call, to 4 February 2027, while the Lot 2 deadline remained unchanged.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: EuroHPC's current call page lists Lot 1 bids due 4 February 2027 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg and Lot 2 bids due 3 December 2026 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg; it says the Lot 1 extension allows Member States to complete national budget procedures and submit financial commitments.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: EuroHPC states that a 5 November technical issue means existing draft and submitted tenders for both lots will not be considered; applicants must recreate and resubmit under replacement links that the authority says it will announce once its technical solution is ready.

evidence_gaps.description: The new submission links and formal Funding & Tenders Portal corrigendum were not available in the inspected page. The contracting authority says replacement links will be announced after its technical solution is ready.
No consortium selection, signed funding commitment, facility construction or operating compute availability is established by these notices.

brief.importance_rationale: If the tender produces operating facilities, its procurement schedule and ability to accept valid bids affect a substantial European AI-compute infrastructure program. The score reflects that possible consequence, not evidence that bids were accepted, funding committed, facilities built, or compute delivered.
limitations: The 5 November update is an official contracting-authority notice, but the replacement submission links and controlling portal corrigendum were not accessible in this review.
The page supports the current deadlines and procedural notice only; no consortium award, funding commitment, facility construction, operating capacity or compute access is established.
The Czech ministry’s 26 October report supplies the date of the Lot 1 extension report; the EuroHPC page does not identify the formal adoption date of that deadline change.
organizations: Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade

The page retains deadlines of 4 February 2027 for Lot 1 and 3 December 2026 for Lot 2. The prior Lot 1 extension was publicly reported by the Czech ministry on 26 October to allow Member States time for national budget procedures and financial commitments. This is a change to the procurement process; it establishes no consortium awards, committed investment, facility construction, operating compute or access.

technical.claimed_result: EuroHPC reports that technical issues invalidate existing draft and submitted tenders for both lots; new submission links are to follow. Current deadlines are 4 February 2027 for Lot 1 and 3 December 2026 for Lot 2.
technical.demonstrated_result: The current official call page shows the lot-specific deadlines and a 5 November update telling applicants to recreate and resubmit under new links because existing tenders will not be considered. The Czech ministry reported the Lot 1 extension on 26 October.
technical.mechanism: The contracting authority says a technical issue caused all draft and submitted tenders in the current system to be disregarded and says it will publish replacement submission links after its technical solution is ready.
technical.regime: EU procurement call EUROHPC-2026-CEI-AIGF-01 for selecting consortia to establish medium-scale (Lot 1) and large-scale (Lot 2) AI Gigafactories.
technical.strongest_baseline: Before the 5 November update, EuroHPC displayed Lot 1 and Lot 2 submission links. It now says all existing drafts/submissions are invalid for both lots and must be recreated under replacement links; the listed lot deadlines remain 4 February 2027 and 3 December 2026.

brief.title: EuroHPC updates AI Gigafactories tender deadlines and invalidates existing submissions
brief.why_it_matters: The submission reset affects the application path for a major European AI-compute procurement, while the lot-specific deadlines remain in place. The authority’s notice supports the procedural change and stated reason; it does not establish selected consortia, financing, built facilities or available compute.
